name: supervisor-kill-gone

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_supervisor.py — kill_worker SIGKILLs and reaps the worker, and answers only after the reap

description: A kill_worker for a worker the supervisor no longer holds — it exited, or was reaped before the request arrived — is answered worker_killed: the worker is gone either way, and a refusal would read to the core as a kill that failed.
